items.summary: fix(knowledge): keep historical claims distinct and reject changed retries (#200140) Reject changed input when retrying any retained Knowledge remember request, including a completed publication. Keep historical claim dates, precision, assertion origin, validity and ownership distinct during duplicate detection. Reserve same-title record paths within each batch so distinct claims publish atomically. Verified with red-on-base regressions, 22 focused Node tests, extension production/test typechecks, changed-file lint and formatting, size/assertion guards, and independent P0-P2 review. No schema migration, live recovery or deployment. Co-authored-by: vincentkoc

items.title: refactor(agents): own background commands and yield waits by the chat…
items.summary: refactor(agents): own background commands and yield waits by the chat (#200097) ## What Problem This Solves Background commands, `sessions_yield` waits and exec-exit wakes were owned by the run that started them. A run id names one attempt, and a chat gets a new one on every turn. So every follow-up run lost the commands of the earlier runs: - A later turn could not yield on a command that an earlier turn started. `listYieldAwaitableExecs(runId)` matched `originRunId === runId`, so `sessions_yield` returned `nothing_pending` and the model started to poll. - A paused subagent task continued only when the wake named the paused run. #200046 patched one caller of this: it moved the running commands to the new run (`moveRunningSessionsToRun`). - Child completions compared the captured requester session id and lifecycle revision. After a reset or a compaction successor, a private completion was withheld with "Subagent results from the previous session were not delivered". ## Why This Change Was Made The bug class is "address work by an id that changes". The chat's session key is the only id that survives edits, resets, compaction and follow-up runs. This PR makes the key the owner: - `listYieldAwaitableExecs`, `awaitExecsForYield` and `openExecYieldResume` are keyed by the chat: agent id plus session key, so a raw shared key such as `global` stays separate per agent. A yield awaits every wake-armed command of the chat, including commands from earlier runs. - Reply admission continues the task that is paused in the chat, whichever run paused it (`continuesPausedTask` replaces `pausedRunId`). - Child and harness completions, and the failure notice of a required completion, go to the requester chat as it is now. The reads of `completionRequesterSessionId` / `LifecycleRevision`, the settle-receipt exact compare, the collector and `agents_wait` incarnation filters, and the reset replacement notice are deleted. - Deleted: `ProcessSession.originRunId`, `moveRunningSessionsToRun` (the #200046 patch), `matchesSubagentRequesterSession`, `recordRequesterReplacementNotice`, `listCollectorRunsForRequesterIncarnation` (now `listCollectorRunsForRequester`). - Kept as a fact only: an exec wake still names the starting run in `inputProvenance.runId` (`ProcessSession.startedByRunId`), because plugins use it (#179816). It routes nothing. - The requester id fields are still written for one release, so a downgrade keeps working. No schema, stored-row or protocol change. Production delta: −227 lines in `src` (+127 / −354); whole PR −427. ## User Impact - A chat can start a background command in one turn and wait for it with `sessions_yield` in a later turn. The exit continues the chat. - A yielded subagent always continues its paused task when one of its commands exits, also after a follow-up run. - A subagent result reaches the parent chat after `/new` or compaction instead of being withheld. ## Evidence Real agent on an isolated source Gateway (`ocx src`, scratch state, port and HOME, scrubbed env), Claude Opus through the shared Claude proxy. base = merge base `96ad377596ca`, head = this PR. | Journey | base | head | |---|---|---| | J1: #200046 incident (paused child, A's exit continues the task in run 2, then B, started by run 1, exits) | parent got `child-final` (with the #200046 patch) | parent got `child-final` (patch deleted); registry `generation=4 delivery=delivered` | | J2: run 1 starts a background command; run 2 calls `sessions_yield` | `{"status":"nothing_pending"}` | `{"status":"yielded"}`; the exit wakes the chat, which replies `j2-woke` | | J3: parent spawns a child and does not yield | ordinary completion (`subagent_announce`) | ordinary completion (`subagent_announce`) | | J1 parent side: parent yields on its child | private completion (`subagent_settle`) | private completion (`subagent_settle`) | Head arms ran on the production code of `3793f6d`; later commits change only tests, docs and the failure-notice path of a required completion, which unit tests cover. A `/new` while the parent is yielded on a running child interrupts the child on both arms, so that journey does not separate them and is not a claim of this PR. Unit: `openclaw-tools.requester-yield.test.ts` now awaits a command with no starting run (fails on base). The delivery tests assert that a private completion reaches a replacement parent session. Gates: oxfmt, oxlint on changed files, `pnpm tsgo:core`, `pnpm check:test-types`, `ocx test` on `src/agents/subagents/`, requester-yield, exec background and notify suites, agents_wait, harness completion, session reactivation and adoption, `src/cron/isolated-agent`. Build, full suites and cross-OS checks: hosted CI on this head. `src/gateway/server-startup-post-attach.test.ts` fails the same way on the merge base `059db8a`; this PR does not touch it. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: CISA警告Check Point權限提升漏洞遭積極利用
items.summary: 上週Check Point揭露鎖定旗下資安閘道的漏洞利用活動，過程中駭客使用零時差漏洞CVE-2026-123039提升權限，後續美國網路安全與基礎設施安全局（CISA）也針對漏洞遭到利用提出警告，呼籲各界提高警覺。

items.title: MongoDB修補可能導致資料庫切換節點時當機的重大漏洞
items.summary: 資料庫軟體業者MongoDB於11月10日修補重大漏洞CVE-2026-118383，CVSS嚴重性評分達9.5。該漏洞源自資料庫複製（Replication）元件，影響MongoDB複製集（replica set）伺服器，涵蓋4.4至9.0等分支版本，使用者應升級至已修補的4.4.32、5.0.35、6.0.30、7.0.48、8.0.37、8.3.16及9.0.7等版本。

items.title: 韓國企業協作平臺DaouOffice傳遭零時差漏洞攻擊，客戶共用帳號又遭暴力破解，至少3家金融業者受駭
items.summary: 韓國企業協作平臺DaouOffice近期接連傳出不同類型的資安事件，服務供應商Daou Technology（다우기술）在11月先後發布兩則安全公告，分別說明產品存取控制漏洞遭利用的攻擊事故，以及企業共用帳號遭暴力破解的情況，強調兩起事故原因不同。值得注意的是，事件影響已陸續浮現，先前的存取控制漏洞攻擊事件波及韓國加密貨幣交易所Bithumb及漢陽證券，後續的帳號暴力破解事件則涉及另一家加密貨幣交易所Flybit，3家金融業者均傳出客戶或員工個資外洩。 從事件揭露的時間來看，DaouOffice相關資安事故先後由受影響企業公布，服務供應商Daou Technology隨後才發布公開說明。

items.title: 微軟Windows本機AI模型將改用Aion Instruct，輸入上下文上限擴大逾9倍
items.summary: 微軟公布Windows裝置端語言模型更替計畫，將以Aion Instruct取代Phi Silica，預計11月20日起先向參與Windows Insider計畫的Copilot+ PC分階段推送，2027年1月下旬擴大至符合硬體條件的正式版Windows裝置。新模型參數量減少，卻能處理更長的輸入內容，並將擴大支援Nvidia RTX及AMD RDNA 4系列GPU。

items.title: Cursor受Fireworks AI事件波及，惡意版Anthropic Claude擴充程式於Cursor市集上架
items.summary: AI程式碼撰寫平臺Cursor 11月13日公告，受到使用的Fireworks AI平臺被駭影響，導致自家外掛平臺上出現了惡意版的Anthropic Claude擴充程式，致使用戶受害。
